war_summary: On Day 110 of War 139, intense front-line combat and frequent base flips continue across key contested hexes and island sectors. Endless Shore remains an epicenter of heavy fighting and constant base turnover, mirrored by sustained naval and island contention in Godcrofts and Oarbreaker. On the mainland, massive casualty surges and recent base transitions dominate Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake, and Speaking Woods as both factions press contested border positions.
